name: cursor-onboarding-platform
status: SKELETON — not published, not loaded, no runtime behavior. Documents the intended platform-core vs library-pack split so extraction is a lift-and-shift, not a rewrite.
description: Portable Cursor onboarding platform (persona SDLC rails) plus a swappable per-library content pack. This fork ships the MONAI pack in-repo for a reliable v1 walkthrough; the manifest below is the extraction contract.
why_skeleton: Publishing this folder as-is would be wrong for other libraries (the pack is MONAI-specific: intensity transforms + Phase 1 loss/metric/network packs). We keep the pack in-repo for v1 and record the split here so the walkthrough stays reliable while showing the productization path.

core.summary: Library-agnostic engine + persona shells. Ships to an org/private Cursor plugin unchanged.

components.pack_config: Path allowlists (STRICT_PREFIXES / EVERYDAY_PREFIXES), deprecated-API patterns, and anti-pattern strings in policy.py / prompt_coach.py are pack-provided config, not core code.
components.extraction_note: Move scripts verbatim; hoist library-specific constants into pack config injected at load.

components.split: The orchestration shell (persona, steps, ledger append, output checklist) is core; the body prose (MONAI transform paths, runtests.sh, changelog format) is pack.
components.extraction_note: Core keeps the skill skeleton + placeholders; pack supplies the library-specific step bodies.

components.split: The detect-drift-then-fail pattern is core; the checked file list + CONTRIBUTING excerpts are pack.
components.extraction_note: Core ships the runner; pack ships the manifest of files to guard.

schema.note: extra keys (persona, stage, skill, path, reason) are open; report aggregates per-persona / per-stage / decision.

components.extraction_note: Schema + report are library-agnostic; ship as-is.

components.split: The structure (boundary explanation, persona map, when-to-use rules/refs/@Docs) is core; the MONAI specifics are pack.
components.extraction_note: Core ships an AGENTS.md template; pack fills library sections.
strict|everyday toggle is core; the allowlist it selects is pack config.

pack.summary: MONAI content: intensity-transform contribution spine plus Phase 1 loss/metric/network archetype packs. One pack per target library; swap this folder to retarget the platform.

components.note: The scanning pattern could be hoisted to core; the MONAI API/changelog specifics stay pack.
Seeded catalog (RobustScaleIntensity primary; AsinhIntensity / TanhSqueezeIntensity backups).
Deprecated np.float arg + missing __all__ registration, caught by check-deprecations.sh and /strengthen-tests.

components.extraction_note: Loss/metric/network packs are MONAI-specific; swap per target library. The scaffold-skill shells are core-shaped but their bodies reference MONAI neighbors, so they ship in the pack for v1.

not_in_v1: Standing persona agents/subagents (skills stay for explicit / stage control)
Hoisting pack config out of core scripts
